theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lp_jc_lipschitz_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (f : Euclid k → ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ fs : ℕ → Euclid k → ℝ, (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fs n)) ∧ (∀ n, LipschitzWith L (fs n)) ∧ TendstoUniformly fs f atTop ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid k)), Tendsto (fun n => fderiv ℝ (fs n) x) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ f x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
